description: Source code for automation service management, including machine loading, saving, event handling, and initialization for an automation system, with IPC and JSON integration.

methods.name: saveMachine
methods.description: Persists a machine JSON object to storage; requires mutex lock.

methods.name: loadMachine
methods.description: Loads a machine's data from storage into internal JSON structure, handling re-transcoding if needed.

methods.name: loadMachines
methods.description: Loads all machines from storage into internal JSON structure at startup.

methods.name: installStockRules
methods.description: Loads default rules from predefined directories and adds them via IPC.

methods.name: automationServiceAddMachineInternal
methods.description: Adds a new machine to internal JSON and optionally enables it.

methods.name: automationServiceInitPhase1
methods.description: Initializes components needed before IPC is enabled.

methods.name: automationServiceInitPhase2
methods.description: Completes initialization, loads machines, installs rules, and starts event loops.

methods.name: automationServiceCleanup
methods.description: Stops event producers, listeners, and cleans up resources.

methods.name: automationServiceRestore
methods.description: Restores system state from a previous backup directory.

methods.name: automationServiceAddMachine
methods.description: Transcodes and adds a machine, enabling it if specified.

methods.name: automationServiceRemoveMachine
methods.description: Removes a machine from internal storage and disables it.

methods.name: automationServiceSetMachineSpecification
methods.description: Updates the specification of a machine and reloads it.

methods.name: getMachineState
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of a machine.

methods.name: automationServiceGetMachineInfos
methods.description: Returns a list of info objects for all machines.
